properties.name: feed.score.engagement-boost-hours
properties.description: Max time-boost (in hours) a viral post gets. A post with 1000+ interactions ranks as if it were this many hours younger.

properties.name: feed.score.affinity-boost-hours
properties.description: Time-boost (in hours) for followee posts. Followee posts rank as if they were this many hours younger than stranger/self posts.

properties.name: feed.score.self-affinity
properties.description: Affinity multiplier for the author's own posts and stranger posts (0–1). Lower than FOLLOWEE (1.0) so own/stranger posts rank slightly below followee posts.
